name: Rosewood Courchevel Le Jardin Alpin
positioning: Ski hotel at the top of the village of Courchevel 1850, with direct piste access, ski butlers and multi-terrace houses
best_for: Skiers who want direct access to the piste
Families or groups wanting a multi-bedroom house or apartment with terraces

facts.text: Rosewood Courchevel sits at the top of the village of Courchevel 1850.
The hotel has direct access to the piste.
SALTO serves alpine flavors with views of the Courchevel slopes.
The Courchevel Two-Bedroom House has a super king bed and four spacious terraces with views of the chalets.
The Saulire House living area is set for fireside gatherings.
Check-in is from 4:00 p.m. and check-out is before 11:00 a.m.
The hotel is smoke-free in all indoor areas.
A baby crib is available free of charge in selected room categories for guests under 3.

highlights.text: The hotel has dedicated ski butlers.
The Jardin Alpin Apartment is a four-bedroom residence with an elevator entrance, expansive terraces, a cinema room, a professional kitchen and outdoor and indoor dining for 12.
The Saulire Two-Bedroom House has lofty ceilings and five terraces framing views of Saulire.
SALTO is the restaurant at the heart of the property, with alpine views.

considerations.text: A deposit of 50% of the total stay is required to confirm a booking.
WhataHotel notes that operation is seasonal, depending on the ski season.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive alpine location.
